scripts.perf:build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @ezerd/web exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @ezerd/web exec vite build --config vite.performance.config.ts
scripts.perf:serve: pnpm --filter @ezerd/web exec vite preview --config vite.performance.config.ts --outDir dist-performance
scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && concurrently -k -n model,contracts,server,web "pnpm --filter @ezerd/model dev" "pnpm --filter @ezerd/contracts dev" "pnpm --filter @ezerd/server dev" "pnpm --filter @ezerd/web dev"
scripts.host:start: pnpm build && pnpm db:migrate && node scripts/host-lan.mjs
scripts.test:ddl: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @ezerd/server build && node scripts/verify-postgres-export.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
